description: Search Viator on demand only when the user asks for activities or excursions. Use a port ID from list_excursion_ports or get_sailing itinerary.portId. Pass the port visit date, not the cruise departure date. Optional q searches activity keywords such as snorkeling or food tours within that port; preserve it across pagination. Returns suggestions near the port, NOT verified time-ashore matches or live availability. Prices are indicative, may differ for the date/party, and are not cruise fares. Preserve complete affiliate URLs. No reviews or protected unique content. No widget.
name: find_port_excursions
title: Find port excursions
